name: hgbeigi-tools
description: Claude Code skills, hooks, mods and small tools from a non-programmer who runs his household and side work with Claude. Each one was used for real before it was published.

plugins.name: subscription-audit
plugins.description: Every recurring charge in your bank and card CSV exports, with a still-used column. Local files only.

plugins.name: vet-outside-skill
plugins.description: Check someone else's skill, plugin or MCP server before you install it.

plugins.name: correction-to-skill
plugins.description: Turn each correction into a dated rule in the file that caused the mistake.

plugins.name: review-gate
plugins.description: A read-only second check, with a reviewer agent, before work is called done.

plugins.name: delegation-kit
plugins.description: How to brief a helper agent, and the shape it hands back in.

plugins.name: session-close
plugins.description: End a session so the next one picks up without the transcript.

plugins.name: check-the-record-first
plugins.description: Search your own files before stating a fact or asking you.

plugins.name: known-limits
plugins.description: A register of what your tools cannot do, and the route that works instead.

plugins.name: commit-privacy-guard
plugins.description: Refuses a commit that holds statements, ledgers, card numbers or private names.

plugins.name: ask-after-searching
plugins.description: Sends a question back once when Claude asks without searching first.

plugins.name: brief-check
plugins.description: Warns when a helper-agent brief misses a needed section.

plugins.name: skill-usage-log
plugins.description: Logs which skills and agents really run, and lists the ones that never did.

plugins.name: unpushed-reminder
plugins.description: Reminds you of commits never pushed, at most once an hour.

plugins.name: weekday-date-check
plugins.description: Flags a weekday that does not match its date in a draft.

plugins.name: skill-trigger-test
plugins.description: Tests whether a skill's description would make it load.
